'The Slayer of Ordo Eris.' One of the slipperiest marks around.|Fennec Shand, regarding Sylar Saris|}} '''Sylar Saris''', also known as "'''The Slayer of Ordo Eris'''," was an [[insectoid]] criminal that was active in the [[Imperial Era]] during or after [[18 BBY]]. After taking out a couple of top bosses of the [[Haxion Brood]] crime syndicate, Saris became highly wanted by powerful individuals in [[the galaxy]], and fled to the planet [[Veelo]]. As a result, [[bounty hunter]] [[Fennec Shand]] began to pursue the bounty on him, eventually hiring the rogue [[Cloning|clones]] [[Hunter]] and [[Wrecker]] to aid her in finding and capturing him. ==Biography== ===A slippery mark=== {{Quote|Got a tip on his location.''"
"''Well, what did he do?''"
"''Hmm. Got greedy. Took out a couple of top bosses for the Haxion Brood and escaped with a cache of credits. Powerful people want him found. The other hunters that went after him? Never came back.|Fennec Shand and Wrecker|}} The [[insectoid]] Sylar Saris took out a couple of top [[boss]]es who were members of the [[Haxion Brood]], a criminal syndicate, and then swindled the group and escaping with a cache of [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] to the [[planet]] [[Veelo]], which he was familiar with, in order to hide. A large [[bounty]] was placed on Saris, who came to be known as "The Slayer of [[Ordo Eris]]" following his run-in with the syndicate, but he proved difficult to catch, setting up [[mine]]s in the [[water]] around his [[Sylar's hideout|hideout]]. Several [[bounty hunter]]s had gone after Saris but failed to capture him and not returned from the hunt, with the insectoid also evading capture when he encountered the bounty hunter [[Fennec Shand]]. During or after [[18 BBY]],{{TBBDate|308}} Shand possessed a [[Holopuck|bounty puck]] for Saris and received a tip on his location. Having been unsuccessful at capturing him previously, Shand regarded the insectoid as hard to capture without a crew. When the rogue [[clone trooper]]s [[Hunter]] and [[Wrecker]] approached her at [[Tanda's Cantina]] on [[Suria space station]] asking for information, she made a deal with them—the two would help her capture Saris in exchange for what they wanted to know. Thus, the trio traveled to Veelo, and Hunter tracked the target until they encountered the mines that the insectoid had set up, unexpectedly disabling them rather then going around them as Saris would expect. ===Hideout ambush=== {{Quote|You think I'd let you slip away from me again?''"
"''Fennec Shand.|Fennec Shand confronts Sylar Saris|}} [[File:SylarSaris-DB.png|thumb|right|300px|Sylar Saris fought Hunter, Wrecker, and Shand on Veelo.]] When Shand, Hunter, and Wrecker arrived at [[Sylar's hideout|Saris' hideout]], they pulled their [[hydroskiff]] to shore and then split up, with Shand remaining lookout at the [[boat]] and the two [[Cloning|clones]] individually searching the base. Saris lay in wait for the hunters, hiding on the ceiling of one of the hideout's rooms until Hunter entered and began examining a wooden grate beneath the insectoid. Chittering and clacking his [[Mouth|mandibles]], Saris leapt down onto Hunter's back, causing the clone to begin firing off [[stun]] shots from his [[DC-17 blaster pistol|blaster]] into the air. Saris then bit Hunter's [[Limb|hand]], causing him to drop the [[Blaster|weapon]], before the clone threw his attacker off. Saris snarled as he landed with a roll and Hunter charged at the insectoid, with the pair exchanging blows until Saris scuttled around Hunter's legs and kicked the clone in the back, stunning him and knocking him to the floor. Chittering, Saris climbed atop the clone, but was knocked across the room by a charging Wrecker, who had seen Hunter's blaster shots. Eluding Wrecker's grasp, Saris screeched and slipped into the shadows then leapt from behind Wrecker and knocked the clone into a wall. With both clones on the ground, Saris opened the wooden grate on the room's floor and leapt down into a crude tunnel below. ===Saris's luck runs out=== {{Quote|You were right to bring us along.''"
"''I'm always right. Grab him and lets go.|Wrecker and Fennec Shand comment on Saris's defeat|}} Wrecker reported Saris's escape underground to Shand over [[Comlink|comms]], causing her to leave the group's boat and allowing their target to sneak from nearby onto the dock. Boarding his own boat, Saris attempted to fire up its [[Engine|thruster]], but after it sputtered and died he looked back to find two of the wires had been cut. Leveling a [[blaster pistol]] at her target from behind, Shand taunted Saris, who turned and recognized her, causing him to laugh. Shand then hit Saris with a stun blast, causing him to flinch, but not stopping him from leaping at her. The bounty hunter missed several shots while Saris was in the air, allowing him to land on her and knock the weapon from her hand before punching her into the water. Leaping onto a nearby rock face, Saris scanned the beach around him and spotted the hunters' vessel, jumping down and running toward it before Wrecker jumped from the shadows and tackled him. Spitting [[acid]] onto the clone's [[helmet]] and impairing his view, the insectoid pushed off his attacker and drew a [[vibroblade]], slashing at the blinded clone. Clearing off the acid, Wrecker grappled with Saris and slammed him onto the ground, allowing Hunter to shoot Saris in the back with a stun blast. Dropping his weapon, Saris turned to Hunter only to be hit with a second blast, before staggering around into a third shot from Wrecker. Wobbling on his feet, Saris then tried to flee before a final shot from Shand incapacitated the insectoid. Commenting that Shand had been right about needing a crew to capture Saris, Wrecker slung the bounty over his shoulder and the trio of hunters left the hideout. Shand then dropped off Wrecker and Hunter back at Suria space station in her [[starship]], the ''[[Outcast]]'',{{SW|url=news/bad-batch-declassified-bad-territory|text=''Bad Batch'' Declassified: 5 Highlights from "Bad Territory"}} before taking Saris to her client. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Sylar knows the planet like the back of his claw. But eventually, everyone's luck runs out.|Fennec Shand|}} Saris was a lean, [[mantis]]-like [[alien]] with [[Color|emerald]] [[eye]]s and green skin. He got greedy and escaped with a cache of [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] after performing a job, resulting in a bounty being placed on his head. He had the ability to spit green acid. He was able to breath the toxic air of Veelo. He stood 2.04 [[meter]]s tall and earned a reputation as one of the slipperiest marks around. He manage to fight off Hunter and Wrecker, even taking multiple stun blasts. ==Equipment== {{Quote|There's dozens of them. And they're all on sensors. We go over them and boom.|Wrecker discussing Saris's mines|}} Saris wore a brown and gray [[helmet]] and a brown [[bandolier]], using a [[vibroknife]] in combat. The hologram on Shand's bounty puck showed him holding a [[blaster pistol]] of an unknown model. His hideout was protected by dozens of underwater mines and he had a hydroskiff ready for escape. ==Behind the scenes== Sylar Saris appeared in "[[Bad Territory]]," the eighth episode of ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'s'' [[The Bad Batch Season 3|third season]], which premiered on [[March 20]], [[2024]].{{SW|url=news/the-bad-batch-season-3-trailer|text=Watch the ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season 3 Trailer}} His voice was provided by [[Jonathan Lipow]]. Although Saris appears visual similar to the [[Yam'rii]] [[species]], the [[StarWars.com]] episode guide for "Bad Territory," released on [[March 21]], 2024, establishes him to be a member of a newly created type of insectoid thought to perhaps be a Yam'rii subspecies. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Sylar Saris}} *{{TBB|Bad Territory}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/bad-territory-episode-guide|text="Bad Territory" Episode Guide | Star Wars: The Bad Batch}} *{{SW|url=news/bad-batch-declassified-bad-territory|text=''Bad Batch'' Declassified: 5 Highlights from "Bad Territory"}} *{{InsiderCite|228|Star Wars: The Bad Batch Season Three Companion|''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season Three Companion}} {{Imo}} *{{Databank|sylar-saris|Sylar Saris}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Sylar Saris |es=Sylar Saris |ja=サイラー・サリス |ka=საილარ სერისი |nl=Sylar Saris }} [[Category:Criminals]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified species]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]]
